subject: MAP: finalize deployment lane & region checkpoints for Stratify Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Pete Holt <pete.holt@stratifyhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: finalize deployment lane & region checkpoints for Stratify Health

Hi Pete —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a lightweight mutual action plan that maps evaluation milestones to a final deployment decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and the region cut we expect to recommend. Attached is MAP-Stratify-v3.xlsx with the proposed timeline.

High level proposal:
- Week 0–2: Technical eval (latency, token cost, end-to-end trace) on Hosted + Dedicated staging images
- Week 2–4: Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence review; if PHI required, run Private deployment proof-of-concept in your VPC
- Week 4–6: Performance soak, SLA alignment, procurement cadence (order forms)
- Goal: customer decision on deployment mode and region by Feb 10 so we can reserve Dedicated capacity or schedule Private install.

Can you confirm the decision gate owners on your side (tech + compliance + procurement) and whether Feb 10 is a workable target? If you prefer a different split (e.g., longer security review), we can adjust the MAP.

Attachments: MAP-Stratify-v3.xlsx, SLA-comparison.pdf

Thanks — look forward to locking this down.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0124

From: Pete Holt <pete.holt@stratifyhealth.com>

Cc: Natalie Green <natalie.green@stratifyhealth.com>, procurement@stratifyhealth.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: finalize deployment lane & region checkpoints for Stratify Health

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear MAP. Quick answers from our side:
- Decision owners: Natalie (compliance), Sam (platform engineering, sam.cox@stratifyhealth.com), and procurement (procurement@stratifyhealth.com).
- We HAVE to validate PHI handling before go-live. If Redwood can demonstrate VPC + HSM/KMS integration during Week 2–4 we can still hit Feb 10 for a decision, otherwise we need a 2-week extension.
- Please include a SOC2 scope extract and a short private-deploy runbook (networking ports, cert exchange).

I'll review the MAP with the team today and confirm whether we want Redwood to spin up a Private POC in our staging VPC or run the Hosted/Dedicated evaluation first. Procurement asked that any financial push (Reserved Dedicated commit) be preceded by a short procurement checklist — I'll attach that separately.

Thanks,
Pete

Team —

Forwarding Pete's note. Key asks from the customer that affect our recommendation:
1) PHI validation and desire for VPC/HSM integration during Week 2–4. They will consider Private POC if Hosted/Dedicated cannot show KMS/HSM proof quickly.
2) Procurement wants a short checklist before any Dedicated commit.

Could you weigh in on the following by EOD tomorrow?
- Karthik: how fast can we stand up a Private POC in their staging VPC (network onboarding, cert exchange)? Rough ETA and blockers.
- Priyom: if we run the Hosted + Dedicated eval first, what evidence do we provide to satisfy the PHI reviewers (KMS integration, audit logs export, data isolation notes)?
- Jordan: pricing note — what cadence do we need to hit for a Dedicated reserve to be feasible for Feb 10 decision?

I attached the latest SLA-comparison.pdf and security-FAQ.pdf for reference. I will keep Pete in the loop but please reply-all so we have a written MAP timeline.

—Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Pete Holt <pete.holt@stratifyhealth.com>, Natalie Green <natalie.green@stratifyhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 17:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: finalize deployment lane & region checkpoints for Stratify Health

Marissa / team / Pete —

Short update and proposed MAP adjustment based on engineering reality:
- Private POC in customer VPC: we can do this, but it is a 7–10 business day onboarding workstream (networking, cert exchange, IAM/KMS handshakes). That means if they sign off to run Private POC by Jan 29 we can complete by Feb 12.
- Hosted/Dedicated security evidence: Priyom and I can provide a KMS integration summary, logs export sample, and a redacted SOC2 evidence packet within 3 business days (target Jan 30). That should satisfy an initial compliance review but not deep PHI validation.
- Recommendation: keep Feb 10 decision gate but change the language: "choose deployment mode based on security gate results." If Stratify wants definitive PHI-handling proof, commit to Private POC completion by Feb 12 and move procurement sign-off target to Feb 18.

Next steps:
- Marissa: update MAP spreadsheet to include two parallel tracks (fast security evidence for Hosted/Dedicated; Private POC path with 7–10 day lead).
- Pete/Natalie: confirm which track you want to run by EOD Jan 29.
- Jordan: escalate any pricing windows for Dedicated to procurement so Pete's team can see the numbers.

I'll attach the minimal onboarding checklist to this thread once I have Pete's network CIDR and a contact for cert exchange.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
